summary: The Tetouan coast holds Morocco's Mediterranean resort marinas -- Marina Smir and the M'diq/Kabila harbours -- a cluster of full-service marinas a short hop east of Tangier and a natural mid-point on the Strait-to-Al-Hoceima chain.
